scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
